note:
Historical (the refresh of this fixture on the combined slot-5 battle and Continue y fixes, commit 5138c1f; every free figure in this paragraph is superseded by the last paragraph of this note): Per-id evidence for the five existing exact-ID refusal groups, kept apart and never counted as coverage. Refreshed on the combined slot-5 battle and Continue y fixes: all 340 original new-tree scenes still refuse; need is unchanged, free is exactly four bytes lower, and shortfall is exactly four bytes larger. Current RPG Move lookup room is 140 bytes (was 144); the 66 original compositions now fall short by 5-42 bytes (was 1-38). All 181 parent refusal twins retain their exact need/free; all 159 parent success twins were freshly rebuilt by the current harness against the pinned archived engine/generator/Mesen. Their historical receipt provenance, including archived harness, and prov.parent remain unchanged. Build-only revalidation establishes capacity outcomes and build-source agreement, not a fresh run of the archived harness or Mesen timing. No IDs or parent outcomes changed; existing exclusions remain conditional on all other required campaign coverage. Source fingerprints must match the current engine/generator.
Historical (phase 3b S2 C1 refresh of this fixture, commit d7fa346; it describes that run only, not the rows as they stand now): all 340 current original scenes refused at their same exact need/free/shortfall; all 340 pinned-parent twins built or refused as recorded. Each of the 159 successful parent twins was rebuilt by the CURRENT scene builders and its normalized-project and ROM sha256 equal the ORIGINAL measurement receipts' (so the archived recipes transfer to the current builders unchanged); the archived harness hash and every parent row's provenance are archived measurement facts and are unchanged, and the current harness is not claimed to equal them. Only this note and the two new-tree fingerprints changed. No Mesen timing refreshed or claimed.
Re-attested 2026-10-18 for Equipment (ROADMAP item 5) C6b by test/lua/refresh_sw_exclusions.mjs (build-only), under Chris's ruling E19. This is a one-time capacity transition, not a re-confirmation: the same 340 ids in the same five groups were rebuilt at engine 1137252e04c6 / generator 0a92b984f69f; every need is unchanged, every free is exactly six bytes lower (140 -> 134 on 262 rows, 97 -> 91 on 78) and every shortfall exactly six bytes larger. The cause is solely commit C1b 720d976 (a six-byte battle-only check in dispatch_input, engine/input.asm, BATTLE_KERNEL_ALLOWANCE_BY_MAPPER +6 on every RPG board); no other commit from f3833db to C6a changes any row's need or free. Current RPG Move lookup room is 134 bytes. The fixture this replaces had sha256 ae6c9fc9783dd16be977fe71728ad38a27ae3af7b104dcd626b746cb2b02e3bd and prov.new engine d5add2c0fc86 / generator a413d8974377. All 181 parent refusals keep their exact need/free; each of the 159 successful parent twins was rebuilt by the CURRENT scene builders and its normalized-project and ROM sha256 equal the ORIGINAL measurement receipts' (the archived recipes transfer to the current builders unchanged); prov.parent and every parent row are unchanged archived facts. Only each row's free and shortfall, prov.new and this note changed. No Mesen timing is refreshed or claimed.
